sessionStart.prompt: Daily Work Loop Copilot is installed. If the user runs /start-day, /my-queue, /next-task, /eod-wrap, or /handoff, load skills/daily-work-loop/SKILL.md and follow plugin commands. Otherwise respond ok with no user message.

Stale attention check (Daily Work Loop): Using $ARGUMENTS, if the user has Bitbucket PR reviews waiting on them or failing CI on their PRs beyond STALE_REVIEW_DAYS (default 2), warn briefly with links to /my-queue --filter=blocked. If unknown, ok silently.

beforeSubmitPrompt.prompt: EOD nudge (Daily Work Loop): From $ARGUMENTS, if the user message suggests ending the work day (e.g. 'done for today', 'logging off', 'EOD') but does not mention eod-wrap or /eod-wrap, return ok:false with reason suggesting they run /eod-wrap for draft Jira updates. Otherwise ok:true.

sessionEnd.prompt: Open loop reminder (Daily Work Loop): Session is ending ($ARGUMENTS). If there was likely code activity today, remind the user once to run /eod-wrap before closing if they have not captured open loops. Keep message one sentence. This is advisory only.
